text:
ella: Kicking off relnotes thread for tomorrow's docs push. Scope: release notes + short migration guide for cache v2, a few SDK snippet fixes, and a one-liner known issue about transient 503s on Dedicated. Can people review?
mike: I can do the copy. We should keep bullets customer-facing and link to the migration guide for the small config changes.
tara: I'll land snippet PRs 705 (py) and 706 (js). Found a JS example that still expects `batchMode: 'legacy'`  will update to `batch: { mode: 'adaptive' }`.
ell a: Note: avoid big code blocks in relnotes. Tiny inline sample ok, link to SDK reference.
tim: Running linkcheck now. Staging build flagged a stale anchor /guides/cache#v1-compat and a dead link to /tools/snippet-lint. I'll add redirects and will run smoke tests after PRs merge.
tara: Snippet diff (small): ```diff
- client.config.batchMode = 'legacy'
+ client.config.batch = { mode: 'adaptive' }
```
mike: Draft bullets: - Adaptive batching (experimental): reduces token-cost spikes for bursty, low-concurrency traffic; opt in via SDK or Console. - Prefix cache v2: faster warmups and lower memory use; see migration guide for a one-line change. - SDK snippet updates: refreshed Python, JS, and Go examples to match new client options. Known issue: Some Dedicated clusters may briefly return 503s during GPU warmup; retrying after ~2030s usually succeeds.
ell a: Good. I'll put the migration guide under content/guides/cache-v2-migration.md and link it from the relnotes.
tim: After PRs land I'll re-run linkcheck and add redirect for /guides/cache#v1-compat -> /guides/cache-v2#compat if needed. Also will run the docs smoke tests (broken anchors, snippet lint).
docs-bot: deploy: branch docs/relnotes-3650012345 deployed to staging; build passed with warnings: stale anchor and snippet-lint notice.
tara: PRs merged: #3705, #3706. I also added a tiny migration example in the guide: `client.set_cache_mode('v2')`. Kept it short.
tim: Re-run complete: redirects applied, smoke tests passed, snippet-lint warnings resolved.
ell a: Homepage blurb option: "Try adaptive batching (experimental) and faster cache warmups with prefix cache v2  see release notes." Approve?
mike: Approve. I'll finalize relnotes copy and publish.
ell a: Merging now. If anything pops up after publish, open a follow-up thread and tag me.
